method: captured from the live grid on 2026-08-07 via raw CDP through the operator's Chrome (Playwright's connect_over_cdp handshake is incompatible with Chrome 151; plain CDP over websockets works), after the operator passed the Smartcaptcha that blocks both datacenter fetches and fresh tabs; trimmed of image src/data-src values, svg bodies and advertising query parameters (ad_params/promotion_provider_id) — badges, size grids, price spans and name nodes are verbatim; the full raw page stays outside git in the capture workspace (not shipped): lamoda_search_page_raw.html

ground_truth.note: three first tiles as displayed on the page: RTLAEY634001 adidas Originals «Кеды HANDBALL SPEZIAL J» 6 569 ₽ was 12 999 (second strikethrough 8 999) with a −49% badge INSIDE the image anchor; MP002XB085KJ Fila «Кроссовки SP EVAN SL B» 2 671 ₽ was 4 110, badge −35%; RTLAEQ981601 Reebok «Кроссовки RBK PREMIER ROAD CONTROL» 6 159 ₽ was 13 999 (second strikethrough 6 999), badge −56%. The badge-inside-anchor layout shadows the extractor's anchor-text title fallback, and the size grid's concatenated digits are the live decoy that must never become a price.

sanitization_note: Removed captured signed advertising/tracking query fields from twelve URLs; product paths, sku/source_rec_type parameters, DOM, titles and visible prices were preserved. This was sanitization of the existing 2026-08-07 capture, not a new capture. Trailing whitespace between HTML nodes was normalized; visible content and price text were unchanged.
